answer: A fresh identity stays expensive to mature: each address locks a refundable bond, then feeds a public work river. Only peer-attested, non-duplicate outputs raise a slowly vesting score; copy-clusters reset it to zero. Every output is sealed with a unique quill — a signature bound to the previous accepted txid and the epoch seed — so a farm that reuses one key links its sockpuppets on-ledger. When volume spikes, a short gale window issues address-specific continuations due before the next block; missed or colliding replies slash the bond together.
